description: This file defines interfaces related to system information and subsystems, including security, network, location, and device identification, for a plugin host in a media middleware framework.

classes.name: IMetadata
classes.description: Interface providing software build information such as hash and version numbers.

classes.name: ISubSystem
classes.description: Interface for accessing and managing various system subsystems like security, network, location, etc.

classes.name: ISubSystem::INotification
classes.description: Interface for notifications about subsystem updates.

classes.name: ISubSystem::ISecurity
classes.description: Interface for security subsystem information, such as callsign.

classes.name: ISubSystem::IInternet
classes.description: Interface for internet connectivity details, including IP address and network type.

classes.name: ISubSystem::ILocation
classes.description: Interface for location information such as timezone, country, region, city, latitude, and longitude.

classes.name: ISubSystem::IIdentifier
classes.description: Interface for device identification details, architecture, chipset, and firmware version.

methods.name: BuildTreeHash
methods.description: Returns a hash representing the build tree version.

methods.name: Register
methods.description: Registers a notification callback for subsystem updates.

methods.name: Set
methods.description: Sets information for a specific subsystem.

methods.name: Get
methods.description: Retrieves information for a specific subsystem.

methods.name: IsActive
methods.description: Checks if a subsystem is active.

methods.name: Version
methods.description: Returns the version of the hosting application.
